setup: Matched release height; red has mass 1 and blue has mass 4.
name: Mass-dependent fall

oracle.name: Mass-dependent fall
oracle.law: Every free body has downward gravitational acceleration g_0√(m_0/m), with m_0=1. Blue (m=4) falls with half the acceleration of red (m=1). Added free bodies follow this law.
oracle.condition: Free bodies with different masses are released together.
oracle.effect: The mass-4 blue ball falls with half the acceleration of mass-1 red.
oracle.scope: All free bodies, including added ones. Equal impulse is not equal initial speed.

reference: Same geometry, masses and scripted actions; the altered program is disabled only in the ordinary-physics reference.
